## History

Prior to sailing on the [Four Sisters](../codex/tech.md#four-sisters), George was engaged to a girl at home and later visited his Uncle Abner when he was seventeen alongside his cousin [Dick Moore](../character/dick.md). Years later, George stayed behind in Cuba to nurse [Dick](../character/dick.md), but a striking resemblance between the cousins resulted in a long-standing identity mix-up. After his true memory returned, George's sister took him back home to [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia), ultimately granting [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) her freedom.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Life P30](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0030), [v3 ch.Interlude P0](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0000), [v3 ch.Interlude P1](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0001), [v3 ch.Interlude P4](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0004), [v3 ch.Interlude P5](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0005), [v3 ch.Interlude P6](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0006), +60 more_

## Relationships

### [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anthony-pye--george.md)

George is the uncle of [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md). Their familial connection as uncle and nephew has been established since the second volume.

- Relative of — uncle and nephew  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045)</sub>

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/george--gilbert-blythe.md)

George is related to [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) as an uncle by marriage to Gilbert's aunt. Their connection is tied to the broader family dynamics surrounding the Moore family, particularly after the revelation of George's true identity cleared up years of confusion regarding his cousin.

- Relative of — uncle by marriage to Gilbert's aunt  <sub>[v3 ch.Revelation P19](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0019)</sub>

### [Pacifique](../character/pacifique.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/george--pacifique.md)

George holds a position of authority over [Pacifique](../character/pacifique.md). He has been established as commanding him since the third volume.

- Commands  <sub>[v3 ch.Revelation P19](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0019)</sub>

### [Dick](../character/dick.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/dick--george.md)

George and [Dick Moore](../character/dick.md) are double cousins who share a striking physical resemblance. This extraordinary likeness caused a years-long identity mix-up that deeply affected those around them until George's memory finally returned and he was brought home to [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia).

- Relative of — double cousins (since v4)  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 32 MISS CORNELIA DISCUSSES THE AFFAIR P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012), [v4 CHAPTER 33 LESLIE RETURNS P11](../source/v04-c33.md#nw-v04-c33-p0011)</sub>
